items.t: اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لَهُ وَاِرْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنْ الخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
items.en: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.
items.tl: Allāhumma ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu, wa ʿāfihi, wa iʿfu ʿanhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassiʿ mudkhalahu, wa ighsilhu bi-l-māʾi wa ath-thalji wa-l-baradi, wa naqqihi mina l-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta ath-thawba l-ʾabyaḍa mina ad-danasi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjā khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhilhu l-jannata, wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabri wa ʿadhābi an-nār

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا، وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا، وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
items.r: ابن ماجة 1/ 480 وأحمد 2/ 368 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 251
items.en: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.
items.tl: Allāhumma ighfir li-ḥayyinā wa mayyitinā, wa shāhidinā wa ghāʾibinā, wa ṣaghīrinā wa ka-byrinā, wa dhakarinā wa unthānā. allāhumma man aḥyaytahu minnā fa aḥyihi ʿalā l-ʾislāmi, waman tawaffaytahu minnā fa tawaffahu ʿalā l-ʾīmāni, allāhumma lā taḥrimnā ajrahu, walā tuḍillanā baʿdah

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ القَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الوَفَاءِ وَالحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَاِرْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.r: أخرجه ابن ماجة، انظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 251 ورواه أبو داود 3/ 211
items.en: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.
items.tl: Allāhumma inna fulāna bna fulānin fī dhimmatika, wa ḥabli jiwārika, faqihi min fitnati l-qabri, wa ʿadhābi an-nāri, wa anta ahlu l-wafāʾi wa-l-ḥaqqi, fa ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu innaka anta l-ghafūru ar-raḥīm

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَاِبْنُ أَمَتِكَ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
items.r: أخرجه الحاكم وصحّحه ووافقه الذّهبيّ 1/ 359 وانظر أحكام الجنائز للألبانيّ ص 125
items.en: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.
items.tl: Allāhumma ʿabduka wa ibnu amatika iḥtāja ilā raḥmatika, wa anta ghaniyyun ʿan ʿadhābihi, in kāna muḥsinan fazid fī ḥasanātihi, waʾin kāna musīʾan fa tajāwaz ʿanh
